verdict.rationale: Morph is an API-first service, so it is headless by nature. You can call it with any OpenAI SDK [morph-docs-17], run offline batch jobs [morph-docs-13], and train Reflexes programmatically by creating a job and polling until it finishes [morph-docs-20]. A community user also drove it from a CLI tool [morph-comm-5]. However, there is no documented CI integration, official CLI, or automation guide. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD usage or examples, an official headless CLI or GitHub Action, and independent corroboration of use in CI pipelines.
